title: Your fitness history belongs to you
intro: Import an independently created synthetic Polar Flow package and explore a provider-neutral daily history.
cancelled: Import cancelled; no history was changed.
exactRepeat: Exact package repeat; history was not duplicated.

outcome.heading: Latest import outcome
outcome.coverageIncomplete: Coverage is incomplete because processing stopped before every artifact was classified.
outcome.rejectedSummary: Import rejected; no history was changed.
outcome.failedSummary: Import failed; no partial history was published.

errors.invalid-supported-artifact: This package contains daily activity that FitFreed cannot validate. Keep the original ZIP and report the compatibility problem; no history was changed.
errors.invalid-source-subject-evidence: FitFreed cannot establish which provider account this package belongs to. Choose the original complete export ZIP; no history was changed.
errors.source-subject-confirmation-required: This package has different or changed account evidence. FitFreed will not merge it with the existing history automatically. Keep the ZIP until account separation and recovery are available; existing history was preserved.
errors.invalid-library-correlation-state: FitFreed cannot verify this library's account-correlation state. Do not import again until the library has been preserved and the problem has been investigated.
errors.invalid-zip-container: This is not a supported ZIP container. Choose the original export ZIP without repacking it.
errors.unsafe-archive-member: The package contains an unsafe file layout. Keep the original ZIP and report the compatibility problem; FitFreed did not extract it.
errors.duplicate-archive-member: The package contains duplicate file names and cannot be imported safely. Request a new export or report the compatibility problem.
errors.archive-resource-limit: The package exceeds a safety limit. Keep the original ZIP and report its approximate size so compatibility can be assessed safely.
errors.archive-io-failure: FitFreed could not read the ZIP. Move it to a local readable folder and try again.
errors.database-failure: FitFreed could not update the local library. Restart the application and retry; if it fails again, preserve the library before reporting the problem.
errors.interrupted: The previous import was interrupted and rolled back. Retry the original ZIP; existing history was preserved.
errors.import-already-active: Another import is already active. Cancel it or wait for it to finish before retrying.
errors.import-coordination-failed: FitFreed could not coordinate the import. Restart the application before retrying.
errors.library-unavailable: The local library is unavailable. Restart FitFreed; if the problem persists, preserve the application data before reporting it.
errors.library-query-failed: FitFreed could not read daily history. Restart the application and try again.
errors.outcome-query-failed: FitFreed could not read the latest import outcome. Restart the application and verify the library before importing again.
errors.preference-query-failed: FitFreed could not read the saved language. The system language is being used for now; restart the application before changing it.
errors.preference-initialization-failed: FitFreed could not save the initial language. The system language will be used for this session; restart the application to try saving it again.
errors.preference-update-failed: FitFreed could not save the selected language. The previous language has been restored; restart the application before trying again.
errors.invalid-locale: That language is not supported by this FitFreed version. Choose English (US) or Spanish (Spain).
errors.desktop-task-failed: The desktop import task stopped unexpectedly. Restart FitFreed and retry the original ZIP.
errors.import-failed: The import could not be completed. Retry once; if it fails again, keep the original ZIP and report the problem.
errors.unexpected: FitFreed encountered an unexpected local error. Restart the application before retrying.
